title: Ultraflat real Littlewood polynomials
summary: For every $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$ and every sufficiently large integer N , there is a polynomial of length N with coefficients in $`\{-1,1\}`$ whose modulus lies between $`(1-\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ and $`(1+\varepsilon)\sqrt N`$ everywhere on the unit circle. Thus real Littlewood polynomials can be ultraflat through every sufficiently large integer length. The signs may be chosen separately at each length.
